Title: Ensure chat status counters and pending-write badges update immediately after reject/approve outcomes (no stale "1 approval pending" state).
Description:
Problem: pending-write counts and badges can drift from reality after mixed approve/reject/block flows, leaving stale approval state in chat history and headers.

Desired outcome:
- Pending counters, badges, and actionable cards reconcile to the same truth after every outcome.
- History reload and thread switching do not preserve stale pending state.

Acceptance criteria:
- Reject, approve, blocked, and mixed-batch outcomes all update header counts and pending panels deterministically.
- Re-opening the affected thread shows the same reconciled state.
- Tests cover mixed-outcome reconciliation, not only visual happy paths.

Validation:
- Reproduce the stale-pending scenario from the audit tracker and confirm it no longer occurs.
- Add a deterministic test around pending-count reconciliation after mixed results and history reload.

Audit note: vetted on 2026-05-24; still relevant even after batch-approval work, because stale pending state remains documented in recent chat-governance testing.
